    Twisting a chosen ray-arrow lift at one arrow #

    For a lift L of the ray arrows (BGRSRayArrowLift), multiply the representative of one arrow by a unit on its target side (L.twistTgt) or source side (L.twistSrc). The result is again a lift (units do not change rays), and it is zero-detecting when L is, under the conditions of MultiplicativeBases/Twisted/TwistLift.lean.
